instructionalState.requirement: Impulse learning data (impulse ID, turn context, pattern extracted, response quality) must be stored in SurrealDB via rpc-api endpoints.
instructionalState.before: RPC API endpoint existed but impulse_mapping_record table was missing from SurrealDB schema. db.create('impulse_mapping_record', record) failed with 'table does not exist' error. Learning data could not be persisted.
instructionalState.after: SurrealDB schema defines impulse_mapping_record table with complete structure. RPC API can now persist learning data successfully. Production-ready for any client to use.
instructionalState.enforcement: Phase 1 Complete - RPC API infrastructure enabled

before.opencodeState: Local learning algorithms (589 lines), local Storage writes

deploym entSteps: 1. Apply schema: cd repos/metabob-rpc-api && surreal import docs/schema/activity_learning_loop.surql

Migration complexity from local to remote storage

Schema-first approach enables clean separation of concerns
Comprehensive indexing strategy designed upfront for query performance

improvements: Add automated schema validation in CI/CD
